title: Program Manager
company: Supernova - AI that helps the world communicate
description:
The Role
 



  





 We're hiring a Program Manager for our marketing team to be the person who makes the weekly marketing plan actually happen. We produce a huge volume of creative every week (500–600\) across teams and partners, and someone needs to hold all the moving parts together, keep everyone aligned, and ensure everything ships on time and to spec.
 



  





 You'll be the connective tissue between our internal teams (content strategy, marketing, content creators, and video editing) and our external network of freelancers and third\-party creative agencies. If you enjoy bringing structure to a fast\-moving environment, working with different teams, and getting things over the finish line, this role is for you.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  




* **Own the weekly marketing plan.** 
 Turn the strategy into a clear, sequenced plan of what needs to be made, by whom, and by when, and make sure it gets executed as planned.
* **Coordinate a large network of freelancers and third\-party creative agencies:** 
 brief them, track deliverables, follow up on timelines, and keep quality and turnaround high.
* **Align internal teams** 
 , including content strategy, marketing, content creators, and video editing, so everyone knows their part and nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Keep every moving part on track.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, and handoffs across multiple workstreams, and unblock things before they become problems.
* **Run the operating cadence:** 
 standups, trackers, and status updates that give everyone clear visibility into what's on time, what's at risk, and what's next.
* **Manage the creative pipeline** 
 from brief to final delivery, making sure output volume and quality stay high week after week.
* **Spot and fix bottlenecks** 
 in the process and continuously make the marketing engine run faster and smoother.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



  




* **3–6 years** 
 in program or project management, production, or operations, ideally in a marketing, creative, content, or agency environment.
* A
 **master coordinator.** 
 You're organized, detail\-oriented, and calm while juggling dozens of deliverables and stakeholders at once.
* Proven experience
 **managing freelancers, vendors, or external agencies** 
 alongside internal teams.
* Strong
 **planning and process instincts.** 
 You build simple systems and trackers that keep everyone aligned and on time.
* Excellent
 **communication and follow\-through.** 
 You chase things down, hold people to timelines, and keep everyone in the loop.
* High ownership and a bias for action, comfortable in a fast\-moving, high\-volume environment.



  





 Good to Have
 



  




* Experience managing
 **high\-volume video or creative production** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **project management tools** 
 .
* Exposure to a
 **fast\-paced consumer or content\-led** 
 company.



  





 Why Supernova
 



  




* **Scale that's genuinely rare.** 
 You'll orchestrate the creative that reaches millions of users every week.
* **High autonomy and real ownership.** 
 You own the plan and make sure it ships.
* **Build in the AI era** 
 , at one of India's standout consumer companies.
* **Work with smart, collaborative people.** 
 We move fast, take the work seriously, and keep the environment easygoing and open.
* **A true meritocracy of ideas.** 
 The best argument wins, not the loudest voice.
* **Competitive salary (10–25 LPA) and generous ESOP.**

* 15\+ years of overall IT experience with significant experience in ServiceNow delivery.
* Strong experience in ServiceNow Systems Integration (SI), implementation, transformation, or managed services.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale ServiceNow programs and complex client engagements.
* Strong expertise in Program Management / Delivery Management / Engagement Management.
* Hands\-on experience with commercial management, estimation, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Strong understanding of change control, risk management, governance, and delivery methodologies.
* Excellent client\-facing and senior stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing geographically distributed and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and large SI environments.
* Exposure to AI, automation, GenAI, or AI\-led delivery models is preferred.

description:
**Professional Services Senior Project Manager**
**Location: Remote (AUS and APAC Time Zone)**
**Department: Professional Services (PS)**
**About The Team**
 Rubrik Professional Services transforms possibilities into outcomes. Our portfolio of services uncovers and exploits the unique opportunities made possible by Rubrik technology. Drawing on our unparalleled product expertise and customer experiences, we collaborate with customers to identify and address complex technical challenges, improve operational efficiency, and maximize their investment in Rubrik.
   

  

 We are 100% focused on customer success, operational excellence, and empowering our team members to grow, lead, and innovate.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high\-energy, strategic, and results\-driven
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer\-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realization, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Beyond managing high\-stakes client engagements, you will serve as an expert in project management within the organization helping to mentor and coach other Project Managers and actively contributing to the development, refinement, and scaling of our PMO governance model, processes, and delivery frameworks.
   

  

**About You**
 As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organization, you will drive impact across three core areas:
 **Delivery Excellence, Leadership \& Mentorship, and Practice Enablement.**
* Project \& Client Delivery Excellence
* Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise\-level customer projects from kickoff to sign\-off within fast\-paced environments.
* Scope \& Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
* Risk \& Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross\-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales, Technical Account Managers), and third\-party partners.
* Quality \& Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.
* PMO Governance \& Process Optimization
* PMO Governance: Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
* Continuous Improvement: Audit project workflows and delivery tools to identify bottlenecks, driving initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
* Resource \& Capacity Planning: Assist in establishing best practices for resource allocation, utilization tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.
* Leadership \& Mentorship
* Coach \& Mentor: Serve as a mentor to associate and mid\-level PMs, providing guidance on client management, conflict resolution, scope control, and career growth.
* Thought Leadership: Share best practices, templates, and lessons learned across the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and high performance.


**Required Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Ideal Profile**
* 8\+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer\-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organization.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification
* Proven experience building or scaling PMO governance models supported by AI, standard delivery methodologies, and project health tracking processes.
* Track record of managing multiple complex, high\-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast\-paced technology environment.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, and developing junior to mid\-level project managers.
* Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.


**Preferred / Plus Qualifications**
* Technical Background: Prior hands\-on experience or foundational knowledge in Data Management, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data Protection, Enterprise Storage, Cybersecurity, or SaaS delivery is a strong plus.
* Additional certifications such as Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI\-ACP), ITIL, or Prosci Change Management.

title: (Sr) Project Manager, Feasibility Site Activation
description:
Project Manager FSA \- India
   

  

 ICON plc is a world\-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.
   

  

 At ICON plc, we are committed to improving and saving lives through clinical research. As a
 **Project Manager – Feasibility \& Site Activation** 
 , you will play a critical role in driving the successful start\-up of global clinical studies.
   

  

 This is a highly visible position where you will take ownership of the Study Start\-Up (SSU) strategy and execution—ensuring that sites are activated efficiently, regulatory pathways are navigated effectively, and studies are positioned for successful delivery from day one.
   

  

 You will work at the center of cross\-functional collaboration, partnering with sponsors, internal teams, and sites worldwide to deliver start\-up excellence at scale.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Shape and execute Study Start\-Up strategies across global, multi\-country studies, ensuring alignment with timelines, scope, and sponsor expectations
* Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive Study Start\-Up Plans, covering regulatory, ethics, and contract execution across all participating countries
* Drive end\-to\-end start\-up activities from site identification through to IP release, maintaining momentum and accountability for key milestones
* Provide strategic input at Bid Defense and Kick\-Off meetings, influencing study design and start\-up feasibility from the outset
* Oversee regulatory and ethics submissions, ensuring high\-quality, compliant, and timely approvals across regions
* Manage site contract and budget negotiations in collaboration with legal, finance, and sponsors, supporting timely site activation
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, implementing mitigation and escalation strategies to protect study timelines
* Partner closely with Project Managers and cross\-functional stakeholders, ensuring seamless integration of start\-up within overall study delivery
* Ensure accuracy, quality, and inspection readiness of all study documentation, including oversight of CTMS and eTMF activities
* Lead and coordinate Study Start\-Up team members, providing direction, support, and oversight to ensure consistent delivery
* Drive process consistency and continuous improvement across regions, contributing to operational excellence initiatives
* Maintain oversight of study metrics, budgets, and scope of work (SOW), ensuring delivery within agreed parameters
* Provide clear, structured reporting and updates to sponsors and internal leadership, enabling informed decision\-making


**Your Profile**
* Proven, recent experience with Study Start‑Up (SSU) as a primary responsibility, including end‑to‑end ownership of site activation activities
* Experience delivering SSU across global or multi‑country clinical studies
* Strong knowledge of regulatory and ethics submission processes, including CA/EC and CTA strategy
* Experience coordinating site contracts and budgets within start‑up timelines
* Demonstrated ability to manage SSU timelines, risks, and competing priorities
* Hands‑on familiarity with CTMS, eTMF, and clinical trial systems
* Solid understanding of ICH‑GCP and applicable regulatory frameworks
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across sponsors, sites, and internal teams
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross‑functional, global teams

description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That\`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Manage small digital and IT projects within a global, virtual, and diverse organization.
* Coordinate project activities, stakeholders, and resources throughout the end\-to\-end project lifecycle.
* Prepare projects and submit them for approval in line with financial, procurement, and governance requirements.
* Support sourcing, onboarding, and offboarding of external resources and suppliers.
* Monitor and report project health, including financials, delivery progress, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Maintain accurate project information and documentation in the PPM tool, while creating portfolio analytics and reports.
* Perform portfolio data\-quality checks and maintain relevant content in the Knowledge Base, communicating clearly with stakeholders and building constructive relationships.


**Who You Are**
* You hold a bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* You bring at least four years of experience in Project management, financial/procurement tracking, portfolio analytics, IT documentation, Power Apps
* You have solid project management skills, including financial tracking, risk management, and delivery oversight across the full project lifecycle.
* You are proficient in Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Query, and apply them to drive reporting and process efficiency.

title: Program Mgr : Cost to Serve, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 About Amazon.com
   

  

 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
   

  

**About RBS**
 RBS is Amazon's cross\-organizational layer connecting Technology, Supply Chain, Operations, and Retail to solve customer problems. The Cost to Serve (CtS) High Risk Value (HRV) team tackles one of Amazon's largest cost leakage pools \- shrink losses from high risk products.
   

  

**The Team Operates Across Three Pillars**
* Defect Identification: Models that flag high\-risk ASINs and surface organized loss patterns earlier than traditional detection methods.
* Defect Elimination: End\-to\-end interventions across the supply chain \- that prevent losses at source.
* Cross\-Org Orchestration: Coordinating across multiple teams to drive shrink reduction at scale. The team's unique value is its ability to see across organizational boundaries and drive accountability through leadership\-tracked cost\-saving goals.


 The primary objective: shift from reactive loss reporting to proactive, mechanism\-driven prevention — reducing Cost to Serve and enabling Free Cash Flow by eliminating shrink at its root cause across the end\-to\-end supply chain.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
 You'll own end\-to\-end shrink reduction programs that directly impact Amazon's bottom line \- from identifying the problem through data and signals, to designing interventions that eliminate losses across the supply chain. This isn't a reporting role; you'll build mechanisms, drive cross\-org alignment across Operations, Technology, Retail, and Supply Chain teams, and see your work translate into measurable cost savings at scale. You’ll join a dynamic, fast\-paced, and supportive team that values innovation and strives to solve real\-world challenges.
   

  

 Are you passionate about tackling intricate problems and finding creative solutions to optimize complex supply chain processes? Do you enjoy turning data\-driven insights into action plans that shape the future? If you’re excited about driving change and influencing outcomes across a global network, this is the opportunity for you.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Diverse Perspectives:
   

  

 We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Whether you’re new to the field, have a non\-traditional background, or have gained expertise in different ways, we value the unique insights you can bring.
   

  

**Commitment To Balance**
 We recognize the importance of maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. We foster an environment where flexibility is not just an option but a priority, ensuring you have the support you need to thrive both at work and at home. When we’re at our best in all areas of life, we’re unstoppable.
   

  

**Inclusive Culture**
 Learning and curiosity are at the heart of our culture. We celebrate what makes us different and support one another through employee\-led groups and ongoing initiatives that champion diversity and inclusion. Our events and learning programs provide a platform for every voice to be heard and valued.
   

  

**Opportunities For Growth**
 As a team dedicated to continuous improvement, we believe in setting ambitious goals and providing the tools to achieve them. You’ll have access to a wealth of mentorship, knowledge\-sharing, and career development resources to help you advance your skills and achieve your professional aspirations.
   

  

 Our team is composed of skilled problem solvers who thrive on tackling cross\-functional challenges. We are dedicated to meeting the needs of our internal stakeholders with a solutions\-oriented approach, always striving for the best possible outcome in everything we do.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Defect Ownership: Use a data\-backwards approach \- mining shrink signals, and operational data, to identify root causes of supply chain defects, then design and implement scalable solutions that eliminate them permanently.
* Cross\-Functional Program Leadership: Form and lead cross\-org teams spanning Operations, Technology, Retail, and Supply Chain to drive programs from ideation through execution with high ownership.
* Data\-Driven Solutioning: Translate complex data patterns into actionable interventions \- sizing the opportunity, building mechanisms that prevent recurrence, and driving results without waiting for direction.
* Stakeholder Management: Drive alignment across multiple lines of business on program milestones, escalations, and process changes.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of comprehensive Cost to Serve (CTS) and Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) programs, including establishing key performance indicators, process mapping, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work with various stakeholders \- such as business leaders, legal, finance, quality, etc. \- to drive the execution of key CTS and UDE initiatives. Provide regular updates to stakeholders and management on escalated issues, ensuring transparency and alignment. Facilitate workshops and meetings to ensure smooth implementation across functions.
* Dive deep into data to identify root causes of inefficiencies and opportunities for cost savings. Track and report key performance indicators related to shrink reduction, defect elimination, and process efficiency. Evaluate network performance metrics to proactively identify process improvement opportunities.
* Utilize Lean, Six Sigma, and other process improvement methodologies to optimize supply chain processes, driving quality, speed, and cost\-effectiveness across initiatives.
* Oversee project timelines, resources, and communication with stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of initiatives. Manage day\-to\-day activities and adjust priorities based on emerging CTS reduction opportunities.
* Lead the expansion of CTS reduction efforts into new regions (e.g., APAC, AMENT/MENA) and fulfillment models (e.g., Fulfilled by Amazon, Merchant Fulfilled Network). Develop scalable solutions to address market\-specific challenges while maintaining quality and aligning with strategic growth goals.
* Apply UDE principles to proactively identify and eliminate defects early in the supply chain, minimizing downstream impacts and driving long\-term cost reductions.
* Build coordination pipelines with finance teams to track cost\-saving measures, ensure accurate reporting, and align financial metrics with the team’s cost\-saving objectives.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field, or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* Analytical skills with proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets
* Experience in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration, with the ability to engage with multiple stakeholders at varied organizational levels


**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience driving process improvements
* Excellent creative thinking skills, with a focus on developing innovative solutions to solve complex problems in a cross\-functional environment, especially under pressure

The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Hardware Architect/Engineering Manager for Electronic Solutions**
 Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Technical Lead/Sr Technical lead to be part of Hardware engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for Hardware subsystems architectural decisions, trade\-off analysis, feasibility studies, Proposal preparation, Project scheduling/costing, Project monitoring and managing and IVVQ for various Thales products (Defense and aerospace applications). This position requires having good level of expertise in its hardware product design, development and qualification.
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 B.Tech/B.E in Electronics, Instrumentation engineering or equivalent with 10\+ years of relevant experience. Higher qualifications of Masters or Post\-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in Avionics systems or defense system is desirable.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Skills \& experience:**

* Must have gained experience in piloting a lot of development work, involving in product testing in external labs for hardware products
* Must have experience in the IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation and Qualification) including requirements management
* Must have strong experience of integration of Hardware, FPGA firmware, mechanical packaging, low\-level software and application software on Hardware unit.

* Knowledge of Certification DO254/DO160, Safety of aeronautical systems (ARP4761\), and Knowledge of ARP4754B will be helpful.
* Product knowledge in avionics fields: civil and military calculators, displays, inertia, GNSS, probes will be helpful.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international multi\-cultural environment (France, Canada, India, UK). Ability to work across different departments and establish effective relationships.

* Proficient in pipeline management, sales techniques, objection handling, and prioritization.
* Proficient in leveraging data\-driven insights to refine customer engagement, adoption, or sales strategies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.

* Ability to collaborate in a fast\-paced team environment, navigate ambiguity, and bring a strong sense of ownership.

* English proficiency.


**Preferred Qualifications**

 Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. title: Tax Consultant/ Senior – Global Innovation and Investment Incentives (Gi3 UK)
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Tax Consultant/ Senior – Global Innovation and Investment Incentives (Gi3 UK)
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Are you interested to work with clients developing innovative and state\-of\-the\-art technologies? Are you driven to contribute to the financing of new emerging technologies and applied sciences? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and have a significant impact to global initiatives?
   

  

 If the answer to above is “Yes,” come join us!
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited started operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP U.S. service lines and regions have been supported by Deloitte Tax in India. In very recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands or the United Kingdom have been supported within their tax practice by Deloitte Tax India practice.
   

  

 The UK government provides tax incentives to businesses performing R\&D; Deloitte’s R\&D tax services group is a market leader in helping clients secure these incentives and is the most experienced team in the UK. We are looking for an open minded Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science (CS) professionals with both technical and software development knowledge, coupled with excellent communication skills. Knowledge of the full development lifecycle is sought and an appreciation of the types of technical challenges encountered across this lifecycle.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 As a Senior within our team, you will be in a client\-facing role from day one, managing engagements, engaging with financial and technical teams, undertaking detailed financial analyses, and utilising your communication skills to quickly understand client costing methodologies. You will review and prepare high\-quality documentation to quantify eligible R\&D expenditure for tax purposes. This will require you to draw on your existing financial and costing experience, applying it to various industries and R\&D projects.
   

  

 You will work as part of a project team alongside tax practitioners to help companies prepare their claims. You will work on multiple projects in parallel and will therefore have to manage several competing demands on your time.
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will allow you to gain an understanding of the financial structures behind a wide variety of cutting\-edge technologies across different industries. You’ll have the opportunity to take a different career route and to maintain exposure to/increase your knowledge of emerging areas of innovation from a financial perspective.
   

  

 To list some of those key responsibilities:
   

  

* Conducting efficient financial interviews with clients’ finance teams to understand their R\&D expenditure, cost allocation, and financial systems.
* Working directly with clients, Deloitte Partners and Directors taking ownership of end\-to\-end engagement management of R\&D tax claim projects.
* Analysing financial documentation and data from clients to support the development of robust R\&D claim methodologies and prepare detailed costing schedules.
* Invest in, mentor and train a cohort of analysts.
* Champion the one\-team culture across our UK and offshore delivery teams.
* Writing clear, compelling financial reports for appropriate authorities (typically HMRC), based on financial analysis to convey how a client’s R\&D expenditure qualifies for tax relief.
* Lead projects to ensure R\&D claims are delivered to time and within budget.
* Working effectively in diverse teams of tax technicians, costing specialists and technical personnel within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.
* Coordinate data automation for multiple projects concurrently.
* Develop expertise and aptitude towards innovation in financial quantification.


 The Team
   

  

 Our “Global Investment and Innovation Incentives (Gi³)” service line is embedded within Deloitte’s T\&L practice and focused on advising companies in their pursuit of the right incentives by developing and executing an effective incentives strategy for their specific needs. The large majority of our Gi³ team members are scientists and engineers. Gi³ team then offers specific related knowledge and added value consultancy. This expertise allows our clients to take advantage of various incentives and grants related to their priorities in terms of Research \& Development \[R\&D], innovation and sustainability. Further development of their intellectual properties and R\&D activities can then leverage on those governmental support.
   

  

 To assist our clients in dealing with those government incentives, our team based in the UK proposes the services of a multi\-disciplinary team of over 100 specialists (Lawyers, Economists, Scientists, Engineers or IT\-specialists) highly experienced in assisting companies with multi\-jurisdictions compliance, dealing with the complexities of local regulations and procedures – such as communicating with local grant and tax authorities, setting up new registrations and preparation \& filling of government incentives applications.
   

  

 We are principally a UK\-based team with colleagues in the Deloitte USI at Bangalore and are looking to further build our Bangalore capability.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 As a senior you will be in a client\-facing role from day one, managing projects, preparing R\&D claims, delegating, and building the team. You will be working with a variety of team members from junior to senior grades and be the main point of contact for your clients.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead projects being the main point of contact with a range of senior stakeholders such as financial controllers, finance directors and chief finance officers.
* Taking ownership over design of costing methodology, and execution of R\&D tax engagements through liaison with internal engagement team to deliver high quality work products under budget.
* Build eminence in the market and look for opportunities to grow the practice.
* Build an internal network within Deloitte and gain an understanding of the services the firm can offer to broaden client relationships and differentiate us in the market.
* Work within a project team to ensure that robust R\&D claims are prepared whilst building deep client relationships.
* Preparing clear reports for submission to HMRC to explain how our clients R\&D claims have been prepared.
* Provide financial input into marketing and sales activity based on your area of costing and tax knowledge.
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.
* Project managing a variety of projects at any given time and being able to delegate and work with the technical and finance team around you.


 Work Location \- Bangalore
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Overview**
 At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
   

  

 Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
   

  

 You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
   

  

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a highly driven and strategic Senior Manager, Software Engineering, to lead the Cloud Core Platform Project, a mission\-critical component of the EMC Software Solutions group. In this senior leadership role, you will oversee the engineering teams responsible for delivering robust, scalable, full\-stack microservices\-based solutions.
   

  

 You will act as the driving force behind our engineering culture, instilling a deep sense of commitment, urgency, and uncompromising quality in everything we build. By aligning technical execution directly with customer needs, you will ensure our solutions provide maximum value. You will guide the overarching system architecture, ensuring the technical excellence of a highly experienced team of Cloud Developers and Test Engineers (each with 8 to 14 years of experience). Furthermore, you will dictate the technical strategy for integrating Zebra technologies, specifically leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern full\-stack microservices ecosystems to solve complex customer challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership \& Delivery Commitment: Provide senior\-level engineering management for the EMC Cloud Platform project. Instill a culture of extreme ownership, commitment, and urgency to meet critical project timelines without sacrificing the stability or quality of the product.
* People Management, Hiring \& Team Growth: Take full ownership of the end\-to\-end people management lifecycle. Actively drive talent acquisition by recruiting, interviewing, and hiring top\-tier full\-stack and cloud engineering talent; establish clear career progression paths, conduct performance evaluations, and build a cohesive, highly motivated engineering team.
* Customer\-Centric Execution: Continuously align engineering efforts with overarching customer needs and business objectives. Ensure the team understands the "why" behind the product, driving features that directly solve real\-world customer pain points and improve user experience.
* Full\-Stack Microservices Architecture: Direct the end\-to\-end technical strategy for cloud\-native product designs. Oversee the development and scaling of full\-stack microservices architectures, ensuring structural integrity and seamless integration across the stack (JSON, Node.js, and React.js).
* Uncompromising Quality \& Operational Excellence: Establish rigorous operational policies and quality standards. Champion the development and implementation of advanced CI/CD practices, automated testing frameworks, and process optimizations to reduce cycle times while achieving zero\-defect deliveries.
* Cross\-Functional \& Executive Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison across Zebra's business units. Frequently interact with Core Platform Zebra Teams and executive leadership to ensure custom application and integration software meet cross\-functional technological and business goals.
* Technology Strategy \& Vision: Guide the engineering team in evaluating and executing complex technical decisions. Drive best practices involving REST APIs, Open API specifications, and the optimal integration of both NoSQL (Firestore) and SQL (PostgreSQL) databases to ensure peak performance and scalability.
* Talent Empowerment \& Mentorship: Act as an internally recognized leader and mentor. Empower senior engineers to push the boundaries of performance, threading, and scalability. Unblock teams rapidly and foster an environment of continuous learning and high accountability.


**Job Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent software engineering discipline.


**Experience \& Leadership Competencies**
* Senior Management \& People Leadership: 15\+ years of extensive software engineering experience, including a strong, multi\-year track record of directly managing, mentoring, and developing software engineering teams.
* Talent Acquisition \& Hiring: Proven experience collaborating with talent acquisition partners to successfully source, interview, and hire highly technical developers, test engineers, and cloud specialists.
* Drive \& Urgency: Demonstrated ability to lead teams with a strong sense of urgency and commitment, successfully navigating fast\-paced environments while maintaining the highest quality standards.
* Customer Empathy: Proven track record of translating complex customer needs into scalable technical solutions, bridging the gap between product management, engineering, and the end\-user.
* Senior Talent Management: Demonstrated expertise in managing, evaluating, and mentoring high\-performing teams of senior developers and Test Engineers.


**Technical Skills (Oversight \& Architecture)**
* Full\-Stack \& Microservices: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and managing highly scalable full\-stack applications and cloud\-native microservices.
* Cloud Expertise: Deep, authoritative knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with significant working experience in the Firebase ecosystem (Firestore SDKs, Cloud Functions, Hosting, etc.).
* Core Technologies: Strong hands\-on architectural knowledge of JSON, Node.js, and React.js.
* API \& Integration: Highly familiar with designing resilient REST APIs and leveraging Open API specifications.
* Database Architectures: Comfortable directing data strategies utilizing both NoSQL and SQL databases, particularly Firestore and PostgreSQL.
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Solid exposure to Docker and Kubernetes for microservices orchestration.
* DevOps \& Scalability: Proficient in driving Git workflows, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring robust application scalability and performance tuning.
* Advanced Problem\-Solving: Exceptional ability to dive into complex technical challenges, debug system\-wide issues, and pivot strategies to keep the engineering team unblocked and moving swiftly.


**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.
   

  

**Job Posting Statement**
 To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
   

  

**AI Technology Statement**
 Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

* Excellent opportunity for a seasoned validation professional to take their career to the next level

* Work with cutting\-edge technology and industry\-leading teams

We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.

 We are looking for a Program Manager –D2C supply chain to own the complete order\-to\-doorstep journey for SriMandir.store.
 



 You'll sit at the intersection of product, tech, and operations, turning messy real\-world problems (a courier underperforming in a pincode, a spike in NDRs, a stakeholder team asking for a metric that doesn't exist yet) into clear, data\-backed fixes. If you like digging into numbers until they tell you what's actually broken, and then fixing it, this role is built for you.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own a set of operating metrics (delivery success, RTO, NDR recovery, dispatch TAT, and whatever else matters as we grow) and build the dashboards and review cadences

* Work directly with courier and logistics partners on allocation, SLAs and escalations, and just as directly with internal teams on process and tooling gaps.
* Design for scale from day one. What works at current volume should hold up
* Get close enough to customer experience data (reviews, complaints, repeat rates) to spot where ops issues are quietly costing us revenue
* Push for standardisation where it helps (SOPs, playbooks for new couriers or warehouses)
* Build the analytics view when one doesn't exist. If a metric matters and there's no dashboard for it



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* You can explain, with data, why a metric moved and what you did about it.
* Operational processes you've touched get measurably better
* Manual, repetitive ops work gets replaced by systems and automations that just run, freeing the team from manual work
* You've built a control tower view (dashboards, alerts, exception flags) that surfaces problems the moment they happen



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-4 years of experience in program management, business analytics, business or product operations
* Strong analytical instincts. Comfortable in Excel and SQL
* Genuine curiosity about how a business works end to end, not just one function of it.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders (product, tech, warehouse, external partners)

**Why This Role?** 




 This is a high\-ownership role where you will directly impact
 **customer experience, operational efficiency and business margins** 
 . You will have the opportunity to build systems and processes that can significantly improve the last\-mile experience for millions of customers.
 



  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys.**

title: Sailpoint Identity Governance & Administration Project Manager
description:
**Job purpose** 




 The IGA Project Manager is responsible for planning and delivering an enterprise Identity Governance \& Administration programme centred on SailPoint. The role will coordinate business, security, technology and third\-party teams to implement reliable identity lifecycle controls, integrate authoritative and target systems, and transition the resulting capabilities into effective business\-as\-usual operation.
 



 The postholder will manage the full project lifecycle, including mobilisation, scope, schedule, budget, resources, governance, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, testing, cutover, adoption and benefits realisation.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Own and maintain the project charter, integrated delivery plan, milestones, budget, resource plan, governance calendar and executive reporting.
* Lead delivery of the SailPoint implementation, including source onboarding, connectors, workflows, roles, policies, access requests, certifications, reporting, testing, cutover and stabilisation.
* Coordinate the design and implementation of joiner, mover and leaver processes, ensuring timely provisioning, access changes and deprovisioning.
* Manage integrations with HR systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud services, service\-management platforms and enterprise applications.
* Coordinate SAP\-related integration activity, including SAP SuccessFactors and/or SAP S/4HANA where relevant to the identity landscape.
* Manage scope, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions and change requests, escalating promptly when delivery outcomes are threatened.
* Ensure project deliverables meet agreed architecture, cyber security, privacy, audit, control and non\-functional requirements.
* Oversee data readiness, identity correlation, role modelling, application onboarding, reconciliation and remediation activities.
* Own the overall test and acceptance approach across system, integration, security, performance and user\-acceptance testing.
* Lead cutover planning, communications, training, operational readiness, service acceptance, hyper\-care and transition to business\-as\-usual support.
* Manage vendors, systems integrators and professional\-services partners against agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, commercial commitments and quality standards.



  





**Person Specific** 




 Essential experience
 


* Proven project\-management experience delivering at least one substantial SailPoint implementation, upgrade or transformation. Experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud is strongly preferred.
* Strong practical experience of identity lifecycle management, including joiners, movers, leavers, access requests, approvals, provisioning, deprovisioning, birth\-right access and access certification.
* Experience leading a project through mobilisation, discovery, design, build, integration, testing, cutover, hyper\-care and transition to operations.
* Experience delivering integrations across HR platforms, directories, cloud/SaaS services and enterprise applications using connectors, APIs or managed file feeds.
* Experience managing complex schedules, budgets, resources, suppliers, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, scope and quality in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience working with cyber security, enterprise architecture, privacy, internal control, audit, service management and business\-process stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of IAM controls, least privilege, role\-based access, segregation of duties, access reviews and audit evidence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, executive reporting, facilitation, negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills.



 Desirable experience
 


* Experience integrating SailPoint with SAP SuccessFactors and/or SAP S/4HANA, including identity attributes, worker events, business roles, provisioning boundaries and reconciliation.
* Knowledge of SAP identity, access and governance concepts, including coordination with SAP security teams and segregation\-of\-duties considerations.
* Experience delivering global or multi\-region programmes involving multiple worker types, legal entities and regional data or operating requirements.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, PAM solutions, cloud platforms and enterprise application\-onboarding patterns.
* Experience with identity data remediation, identity correlation, role mining, application rationalisation and phased onboarding at scale.
* Experience managing software vendors, professional\-services partners and outcome\-based statements of work.



 Qualifications
 


* A recognised project or programme management qualification such as PRINCE2, PMP or MSP, or equivalent practical delivery experience.
* Agile delivery qualification or demonstrable experience applying Agile or hybrid delivery approaches.
* SailPoint accreditation and/or a recognised IAM or cyber security certification is advantageous.



 Skills and competencies
 


* Strong leadership, organisation and delivery discipline.
* Ability to translate technical, security and control requirements into clear plans and decisions.
* Commercial awareness and effective supplier management.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and resolve competing priorities.
* Analytical, evidence\-based approach to problem solving and reporting.
* Commitment to security, privacy, quality, auditability and operational readiness

title: Program Manager, AI Data Ops
description:
**About AiDASH**
 AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
   

  

 The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.
   

  

 Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 AiDASH is looking for a high\-agency Program Manager to help scale our AI Data Ops function: the team responsible for sourcing, processing, and annotating the satellite and remote sensing imagery that powers our AI/ML models.
   

  

 This role is a new addition to the leadership team, created specifically to bring an
 **automation\-first, numbers\-backed, process\-driven** 
 operating model to how Ops runs . This role is designed to reduce operational complexity over time, not to manage individual queues or projects indefinitely. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, vendor management, and data science delivery, helping AI Data Ops evolve from a fast\-scaling function into a well\-designed, repeatable operating system.
   

  

 You will need to zoom in to solve real problems on the ground — a stuck vendor SLA, a high priority escalation, a broken handoff — and zoom out to design the processes, playbooks, and automation that stop the same problems from recurring.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, build\-from\-scratch role: you'll be judged on the systems and habits you install, not just the projects you close.
   

  

 How You’ll Make an Impact:
   

  

**Automation \& AI\-native ways of working**
* Identify repetitive, manual workflows across annotation, QA, imagery processing and reporting, and drive their automation — via internal tooling, scripting, RPA, or AI\-assisted workflows.
* Build and own the automation roadmap and drive it seamlessly across the team


**Program \& project management**
* Run structured program governance (milestones, RAID logs, status cadence) across cross\-functional initiatives that no single manager owns end\-to\-end.
* Bring discipline — timelines, ownership, dependencies — to all team initiatives


**Cost reduction**
* Own a cost\-efficiency roadmap for Ops: vendor spend, tooling spends, rework/error costs, and capacity utilization.
* Build the business case and track savings with real numbers\- Clear visible impact


**Vendor performance frameworks**
* Design and own scorecards/SLAs for imagery, annotation and other third\-party vendors.
* Run regular vendor performance reviews and own escalation/renewal/replacement decisions in partnership with managers.


**Cross\-functional ownership \& data ownership**
* Serve as the connective tissue across all managers and leads — surfacing shared problems (tooling, process, vendor etc) that no single manager can fix alone.
* Own org\-wide SOP creation and the dashboard/metrics layer (throughput, quality, SLA, utilization) so every manager works off the same numbers.


**Enable leadership with insight and structure**
* Build dashboards/reports tracking throughput, accuracy, vendor performance, and cost efficiency; define KPIs that drive decisions on quality, capacity, and cost
* Manage budgets across data sourcing, annotation ops, and vendor contracts, identifying cost\-optimization opportunities
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured, actionable plans


 What We're Looking For:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience spanning program/project management, business operations, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to automation, Ops, vendor management and cost optimization.
* A genuine track record of building metrics/automation programs from scratch — not just running ones someone else designed.
* Comfort with data: you should be able to build and defend a dashboard or a business case yourself, not just commission one.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the face of Ops in external conversations.
* Experience managing external vendors/partners and negotiating SLAs.
* Bonus: prior exposure to GIS, geospatial, imagery, or annotation\-heavy operations; experience standing up automation/RPA/AI tooling programs (This is not mandatory)
* Must\-have: hands\-on experience working in a startup environment.


 We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.
   

  

 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI\-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost\-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low\-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self\-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI\-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise\-grade decision\-making.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long\-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.
* Define specific systems programs and create a plan of action for realizing those programs. Such programs could be around capacity planning, migration efforts, high availability, network architecture, performance optimization, reliability improvements and more.
* Use your technical understanding of Atlassian and related systems to partner with and influence engineers and architects in making progress on these problems.
* Responsible for taking a systematic approach to engineering problems. This includes: prioritizing tasks, scoping out the project, defining objectives, and making consistent progress against each of these.
* Be accountable for the success of these technical programs by managing the entire lifecycle from initiation to forecasting, budgeting, scheduling, etc.
* Manage complex dependencies and projects with a broad scope across the company


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience on software teams as Development Manager or TPM
* Strategic thinking and ability to understand business objectives to translate them into technical problems and programs.
* Technical understanding of systems involved. Willingness to develop domain expertise in the area they operate \- storage, networking, authentication, capacity management, service deployments, etc.
+ TPMs are not expected to write or read code, but are expected to understand system flows, block architectures, APIs and such.

* Experience defining and running end\-to\-end complex technical programs
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Description**
 ou are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact. Your program may focus on a single process path in a critical business area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a significant business objective. You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that are not tied to any program. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and/or ownership of one or more organizational goals. You are accountable for overall program strategy as well as tactically driving teams in and outside your organization to deliver. You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the significant business problems in your program space, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind leadership decisions (Q: Why did we deliver X? What business goal does it solve? Do we need to deliver something else\-\- if so why, and what? ).
   

  

 To ensure stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions. You provide a long\-term perspective, context (past, current, and future) for business and technology (at a high level) choices. You partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine what projects move forward and in what priority order. You use your judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to deliver this at all?). You enlist senior individual contributors and leaders to ensure solutions scale (or will scale). You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. deliverables). You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes. You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and systems. You help teams and/or your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood or documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from third\-party solutions, security not considered, insufficient stakeholder review, etc.). You are able to solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships). You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
   

  

 You understand and share program\-management best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess processes, program plans, and operational requirements. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process. You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction. You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (e.g., Amazon 6\-pager, PR/FAQ, reporting, etc.) and present them effectively to directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus). You actively recruit and develop others by mentoring in your organization and/or at your location. You provide constructive peer feedback and promotion assessments for lower level PMs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Generally works within a VP org. Influences large customer segments, technology decisions, external entity interaction, etc. Actively mentors and develops others.
   

  

 Work is tactical and strategic. Owns a large program. Manages the lifecycle of complex initiatives. Unblocks teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities. Learning to force multiply . Escalates effectively. Able to find a path forward in difficult situations. Makes trade\-offs between short\-term needs vs. long\-term needs.
   

  

 High impact on. Org goals, and program\-related metrics. May have cross\- region impact
   

  

 Improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess process. Drives efficiencies. Creates predictable process paths.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

 WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.

description:
**Description**
 We are building Amazon's first horizontal self\-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule\-based systems into outcome\-learning, context\-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross\-org coordination, and production launch governance.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end\-to\-end — from first contact through production launch and steady\-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi\-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Tenant Onboarding Execution
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
* Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
* Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross\-org dependencies.


 Cross\-Org Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate multi\-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
* Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant\-side engineering.
* Serve as the single\-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.


 Process Design \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
* Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self\-serve at scale.


 Data Readiness \& Pre\-flight
   

  

* Drive data readiness (the \#1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
* Coordinate pre\-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
* Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.


 Governance \& Launch Readiness
   

  

* Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail\-safes, RACI sign\-off), and transition to steady\-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.


 Pipeline \& Reporting
   

  

* Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time\-to\-production, blocker resolution.
* Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding\-ready tenants.


**About The Team**
 We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan\-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
   

  

 You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant\-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
* Experience managing multi\-party programs with cross\-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
* Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5\+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience in platform onboarding, developer ecosystem programs, or internal tooling adoption at large\-scale technology organizations
* Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance
* Background in building scalable onboarding processes that reduce per\-tenant effort over time (self\-serve model design)
* Experience with change management in multi\-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross\-functional alignment

title: Associate Program Manager - Partnerships
description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program.
