* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.

description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience

description:
**About us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about Target In India**  

  

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Pyramid Overview**


Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the design, products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our guests, guest segments and behaviors, business objectives, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award\-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.


Target in India Marketing delivers differentiating yet relevant marketing communication solutions across channels operating as an integrated ONE global team and it strives to bring excellence every time in how they create, connect and collaborate.


A role with **Target in India Marketing** is an opportunity to work with some of the best in the business for marketing, creative, strategy \& digital and you’d lead/contribute to work that connects to millions of guests. Your influence will drive sales and grow brand love through work that’s guest\-centric, on brand, category relevant and channel focused.

**Target Creative’s Brand Design Lab** is the in\-house creative/design team dedicated to bringing some of the world’s most beloved and recognizable owned brands to life. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. As a Sr. Project Management Analyst, Marketing, Brand Design Lab you will operate at the intersection of your creative team and the business. At the core you are expected to lead projects at category level or deliver to business objectives working alongside with your team.

* Having a developed sense of design, a strong understanding of Brand Building, Packaging Design, and Design systems. Being meticulous and have an excellent eye for detail and brand consistency. Understanding /awareness of the global culture. Keeps abreast of current design trends
* Excellent ability to communicate design thinking and effective presentation skills. Communicate design strategy to various audiences in a strategic manner
* Lead creative project management process optimization, documentation of processes, standards, and guidelines. Organize and plan details for multiple projects and make timely and quick decisions to meet project deadlines

description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance's current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.

description:
Job Title Senior Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description 1. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side. The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution. Preferred M.Tech / MBA / Post Graduate qualification in Construction or Project Management. PMP / PMI / RICS or equivalent professional certification is an advantage. 19. Experience Requirements 15+ years of total experience in construction/project management. Minimum 810 years in Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager / PMC leadership roles preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale building projects. Strong Client/PMC-side experience preferred. Experience managing multiple contractors and consultants. Experience in large and complex projects with significant civil, architectural, MEP and specialist interfaces. Preferred Project Experience Experience in one or more of the following: High-rise residential developments Commercial developments Super-speciality hospitals Hotels and hospitality Mixed-use developments Institutional projects Large corporate campuses 20. Technical & Professional Competencies Strong working knowledge of: Construction Management Project Management Primavera P6 / MS Project Project Controls Contract Administration FIDIC / EPC / Design & Build / Item Rate Contracts Cost Management Quantity Surveying fundamentals Variations & Change Management Claims & EOT Delay Analysis Quality Management HSE Management Procurement Management Risk Management Design Management MEP Coordination Testing & Commissioning Advanced MS Excel and MS Office BIM coordination awareness Project dashboards/MIS 21. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent Client and stakeholder-management capability. Strong technical understanding of building construction. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Ability to challenge contractors objectively and professionally. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to make decisions under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong presentation skills. High degree of ownership and accountability. Ability to manage multiple priorities and interfaces. Proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation. 22. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project Delivery Achievement of project milestones. Overall programme performance. Effectiveness of recovery strategies. Cost Project cost within approved budget. Control of variations and claims. Accuracy of cost forecasting. Contractor Performance Contractor productivity. Resource deployment. Schedule adherence. Quality and HSE performance. Quality Reduction in NCRs and recurring defects. Timely closure of quality issues. Successful completion and handover. Safety HSE compliance. Reduction/prevention of incidents. Timely closure of safety observations. Client Satisfaction Quality and transparency of reporting. Timely resolution of issues. Quality of recommendations. Effective stakeholder coordination. 23. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a senior construction professional with strong PMC/Client-side experience , capable of independently managing the delivery of a major project and providing objective advice to the Client. He/she should be able to move beyond routine supervision and provide strategic project leadership , with a strong understanding of: Programme + Cost + Quality + Safety + Contracts + Claims + Procurement + Design + Construction The candidate should be comfortable challenging major contractors such as L&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons or equivalent , while maintaining a professional and collaborative relationship. The successful candidate should be able to look at a project from the Client''s overall perspective , identify the root cause of problems, quantify their impact, recommend corrective action and drive the project team and contractors towards achieving the agreed project objectives. Location Bangalore, Karnataka The role requires full-time presence at the project site with regular interaction with the Client, consultants, contractors, vendors and other project stakeholders. **Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

**Job Overview**


As a Senior Champion Program Manager (Sr. CPM), your role involves fostering growth, as well as establishing, and nurturing robust connections with Atlassian Champions across APAC supporting them to contribute to the community to have the most impact, and activating them in ways that support business priorities such as driving company user groups, community events, forum contributions, and content creation.


Responsibilities:
**What you’ll own**

**As a senior member of the Champion Engagement \& Experiences team, you’ll drive engagement \& operational excellence for the Champion program.** You are the subject\-matter expert and owner for the operational backbone, keeping the systems, documentation, and engagement mechanics that the whole team runs on healthy and scalable. You’ll:

* Drive program operational excellence: the health of the Champion tech stack, internal and external documentation management, and engagement health metrics
* Obsess over optimizing the program to enhance the Champion experience by launching annual surveys and collecting feedback on a regular basis
* Act as the Champion representative for all Champion Support and Platform \& Delivery\-facing projects such as a CRM migration and revamping the Perks \& Rewards ecosystem
* Serve as point of contact for Champion enablement collaborations such as Champion Hub, lifecycle emails, and Champion Workshops
* Handle first line of escalations and provide recommendations for CPM’s next steps


On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll cultivate a sense of trust and belonging in the community by engaging with Atlassian Champions through:

* A private Slack community, private forum groups, email, and in person
* Monthly virtual events such as Coffee Chats and Office Hours with regional Champions
* Highlight Champion stories and share APAC regional accomplishments on a consistent basis across quarterly reports, Slack channels, and blog posts
* An Annual Regional Connect event that you’ll host to reward top performing Champions in APAC
* Enforcement of the Champion Program Guidelines


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:
**More about you**


To be successful in this role, you will need to be a big\-picture thinker and also able to dive deep into the details that help our Champions feel seen and heard. You're extremely empathetic; you care about what customers need and want to help them achieve their goals. Also:

* 3\+ years of proven experience building, scaling, and influencing the strategy of community, advocacy, or ambassador programs (especially chapter or user\-led models)
* You are a disciplined program operator and business\-rules owner who clearly articulates program needs and outcomes, defines user journeys, anticipates edge cases, and owns documentation, SOPs, and tooling health
* You are able to prioritize, manage deadlines and work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, highly dynamic environment; highly organized, with the ability to work with multiple teams in different countries
* You can seamlessly shift gears between different working styles and regularly learn new processes
* You're a strong communicator and have excellent writing skills
* You’re skilled at advancing and growing relationships with stakeholders/partners and driving executive interactions and alignment with stakeholders and marketing teams
* You're energized by building strong relationships with a diverse group of customers and attending user\-driven events
* You appreciate thinking outside the box, operate with a sense of urgency, and have a knack for finding unique solutions to problems
* You're comfortable working autonomously, but also thrive in a team setting


And it's admired, but not required, if:

* You have experience working in Atlassian products, plus Slack, HubSpot, and Salesforce (added bonus if you're familiar with Bevy and/or Higher Logic Vanilla, Tableau)

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability

title: Senior Program Manager – HIMS Implementation
description:
Job Description for Senior Program Manager – HIMS Implementation
 
  
 



**KareXpert Overview:** 
  
 



 KareXpert Technologies is a Reliance Jio\-backed healthcare technology company offering an AI\-powered, cloud\-based Digital Healthcare Platform. With 60\+ integrated modules, including HIMS, EMR/EHR, Telemedicine, LIMS, RIS/PACS, Pharmacy, IoT, and Advanced Analytics, KareXpert enables hospitals to deliver connected, efficient, and patient\-centric care.
 



 Recognized as the winner of the
 **NASSCOM Hospital Innovation Challenge** 
 and selected for the
 **Google for Startups Accelerator India** 
 , KareXpert works with leading global technology partners such as Google, Microsoft, Oracle, AWS, GE Healthcare, and KPMG to drive digital transformation in healthcare.. 
 



   
 


**Lead Digital Transformation in Healthcare** 

 Are you passionate about leveraging healthcare technology to transform hospital operations and improve patient care? Join KareXpert and lead large\-scale HIMS implementations across some of the region's leading healthcare institutions. From project kickoff to go\-live and stabilization, you will work closely with hospital leadership, clinical teams, and cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful digital healthcare solutions.
 


**What You'll Do** 
**Program Leadership \& Governance** 
* Act as the face of KareXpert leadership for assigned customer engagements.
* Lead end\-to\-end HIMS implementation programs across multiple hospitals and healthcare networks.
* Drive resource planning, mobilization, and deployment to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage Steering Committee (SteerCo) meetings, executive reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Develop project plans, implementation roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and governance frameworks.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks; proactively raise red flags and drive corrective actions.
* Govern project KPIs related to scope, cost, quality, timelines, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring delivery excellence.
* Partner with Finance teams to monitor revenue realization, collections, project profitability, and commercial milestones.
* Drive process compliance, operational governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.
* Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new clinical and operational workflows.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 
* Build strong relationships with hospital CXOs, clinical leadership, IT teams, and operational stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for project\-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct executive presentations, business reviews, and program status updates for senior leadership.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and transparent communication.


**People Leadership** 
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10\+ professionals across implementation, clinical, training, and technical functions.
* Drive team performance, capability development, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer\-centric delivery.


**Technical \& Solution Leadership** 
* Possess strong hands\-on knowledge of Hospital Information Management Systems (HIMS) and healthcare workflows.
* Lead solution discussions, implementation planning, and technical workshops with customers.
* Drive system configuration, workflow validation, training, testing, go\-live, and post\-go\-live support activities.
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor team members on HIMS modules and implementation best practices.
* Ensure seamless integration of HIMS with third\-party healthcare and enterprise systems.


**Travel \& Deployment** 
* Be available for onsite engagement as required by business and project needs.
* Demonstrate flexibility and enthusiasm for extensive travel, including local, domestic, and international assignments.


**What You Bring** 
* MBA (Healthcare) / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics) / MCA.
* 5–8 years of experience in Healthcare IT and HIMS implementation.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale healthcare implementation programs.
* Successful track record of implementing solutions for multi\-chain hospital groups or hospitals with 500\+ beds.
* Strong understanding of hospital operations, clinical workflows, and post\-go\-live support processes.
* Demonstrated experience in managing SteerCo meetings, executive stakeholders, escalations, and project governance.
* Proven experience leading and managing teams of 10 or more professionals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced environments, make decisions under ambiguity, and drive outcomes.


**Nice to Have** 
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PgMP (Program Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Agile / Scrum Certifications
* Healthcare Informatics or Digital Health Certifications


**Why Join KareXpert?** 
* Drive meaningful digital transformation across leading healthcare organizations.
* Own high\-impact projects from strategy to execution and see your work directly improve healthcare delivery.
* Work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to large\-scale healthcare technology programs.
* Lead diverse teams, manage key customer relationships, and accelerate your career in healthcare technology leadership.
* Opportunity to work on challenging projects across India and international markets.


**Location** 

**Bangalore / Hyderabad** 



**Language Requirements** 
* English – Fluent (Speaking, Reading, and Writing) – Mandatory
* Hindi – Preferred
* Any regional language (Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu) – Preferred and advantageous based on deployment location.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Project Manager**

**Location:**

**Reporting To:** 
 Office Leadership
 



  





**About Us** 




 Agriplast Protected Cultivation is a greenhouse manufacturing company in India that builds large\-scale commercial greenhouse farms. Our range consists of Polyhouse, Greenhouse, Net Houses and Poly tunnels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Agriplast is scaling rapidly across domestic and international markets and is building out a strong project execution function to match. We are looking for a seasoned project leader to own the complete execution agenda from order handover and site mobilization through installation, commissioning, and client sign\-off across all project sites.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can build process and drive on\-ground execution simultaneously in a fast\-growing, project\- and manufacturing\-driven business. The ideal candidate will bring a superior strategic outlook and “get things done” leadership skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Strategy \& Planning** 




 •     Develop and execute the overall project execution strategy for domestic and international sites.
 



 •     Build detailed project plans, timelines, and resource/manpower deployment plans for each site.
 



**2\. Installation \& Project Execution** 




 •     Own end\-to\-end installation and commissioning of Polyhouses, Greenhouses, Net Houses and Poly tunnels at client sites.
 



 •     Ensure timely closure and handover of all critical and strategic projects within scope, budget and quality.
 



**3\. Vendor, Contractor \& Site Team Management** 




 •     Build and manage a reliable network of installation contractors, civil teams, and site supervisors/engineers across regions.

**4\. Quality, Safety \& Standards** 




 •     Establish and enforce quality control checkpoints and site safety protocols across all projects.
 



 •     Conduct regular site audits and inspections to ensure adherence to engineering, design and safety standards.
 



**5\. Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 •     Act as the primary escalation point for clients during execution, managing expectations and resolving on\-site issues.
 



 •     Coordinate closely with design, procurement, manufacturing and logistics teams to ensure seamless handoffs from order to site.
 



**6\. Cost, Budget \& Resource Control** 




 •     Monitor project costs against budget, control overruns, and protect project\-level profitability.
 



 •     Track material consumption, minimize wastage, and optimize deployment of manpower and equipment across sites.
 



**7\. Project Analytics, Systems \& Reporting** 




 •     Implement project management systems, dashboards and site\-tracking tools.
 



 •     Track and report the Project Execution scorecard to leadership across the following KPIs:
 



 •     Project Completion Rate (On\-Time)
 



 •     Installation Cycle Time (Order to Handover)
 



 •     Cost Variance / Budget Adherence
 



 •     Client Satisfaction / Handover Score
 



 •     Site Safety Incident Rate
 



 •     Quality Rework Rate
 



 •     Resource \& Equipment Utilization Rate
 



 •     Vendor/Contractor Performance Score
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 •     Experience: 12\+ years in project execution/installation management, including substantial time in a senior/leadership role, ideally in greenhouse, structural steel, construction, infrastructure or EPC project execution.
 



 •     Execution Track Record: Proven track record delivering large\-scale, multi\-site installation/construction projects on time, on budget and to quality standards.
 



 •     Vendor \& Contractor Management: Strong network and hands\-on experience managing multi\-site contractor, civil and labour teams.

This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.

* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

* Establish program governance, milestones, and reporting mechanisms



**SDV Architecture \& Platform Planning** 



* Partner with engineering on SDV architecture (central compute, zonal, cloud integration) and the vehicle OS, middleware, API, and OTA stack
* Ensure alignment with global SDV platforms (Arene, QNX, Android, cloud ecosystems)

**Ecosystem \& Partner Alignment** 



* Coordinate with global stakeholders (TMC, Woven, TMNA, TRI), Tier\-1 suppliers (Denso, Panasonic, AISIN), and technology partners

**Connected Operations \& Lifecycle Management** 



* Define lifecycle capabilities: OTA updates, feature enablement/disablement, subscription models, and feature monetisation
* Establish frameworks for release management, feature rollout, and post\-launch performance monitoring
* Use data\-driven insights to drive continuous improvement



**Business Case \& Value Realization** 



* Build ROI models covering cost reduction (ECU consolidation, software reuse) and new revenue (subscriptions, feature unlocks)
* Align the SDV roadmap with vehicle volumes, pricing strategy, and customer lifetime value



**Capability Building** 



* Identify gaps and drive capability development in SDV engineering (embedded, cloud, DevOps), tools, and testing frameworks
* Support creation of SDV labs, prototyping, and simulation environments



**You are a successful candidate if you:** 



* 10\+ years in automotive product planning, program management, or strategy — preferably with OEM or Tier\-1 experience in connected/SDV domains
* Bachelor’s in engineering (Computer Science, Electronics, or Automotive); MBA or equivalent business exposure preferred
* Understanding of SDV architecture — central compute, zonal ECUs, OTA, vehicle OS, and cloud integration concepts
* Experience driving cross\-functional programs spanning business, engineering, IT, and digital teams across multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to build and execute technology roadmaps aligned with global platforms and localised for regional markets
* Experience with connected\-vehicle lifecycle management — OTA release planning, feature enablement, and post\-launch performance analytics
* Business acumen to build ROI models — ECU consolidation savings, subscription revenue, feature monetisation, and lifecycle value
* Excellent stakeholder management and program governance — experience with Japanese OEM culture, global affiliates, and cross\-region structures; able to define KPIs and report to senior leadership (familiarity with platform partnerships such as QNX, Android Automotive a plus)

**Innovative:**

**Collaborative:**

 Work with cross\-functional teams to align PLM structures with ongoing project workflows and documentation needs.

As the UK’s leading Digital Manufacturing Marketplace, we offer an AI\-powered B2B MaaS (Manufacturing as a Service) solution, seamlessly connecting buyers and suppliers to drive efficiency and innovation.

 Check out our website!

Our primary customers include Design Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, and Procurement teams, all of whom are involved in creating the world’s most innovative products.
   

  

 See our platform in action!
   

  

**About the Role:**
 As a
 **Project manager** 
 at Geomiq, you will be the key liaison between our UK team, Manufacturing Partners, and Bengaluru Quality hub. Your role is to ensure seamless order fulfilment, optimize vendor performance, and uphold high\-quality standards.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the primary contact for manufacturing partners, ensuring they have the necessary resources and technical data.
* Experience in managing and dealing with vendors, specifically within the CNC or Sheet Metal area.
* Track production progress, address quality concerns, and mitigate delays.
* Oversee order execution, ensuring on\-time delivery and adherence to specifications.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and manage logistics between vendors, QC, and shipping teams.
* Ensure vendors understand customer design requirements and technical specifications.
* Facilitate technical communication between all stakeholders.
* Support quality assurance by guiding vendors and resolving pre\-shipment issues with the QC team.
* Provide feedback to improve vendor management systems and customer experience.
* Maintain confidentiality of Geomiq’s supply chain and customer data.


**Experience Required:**
* 2 to 5 years of experience
* Proven experience in project management, supply chain, or manufacturing operations.
* Strong background in vendor management, quality control, and logistics.
* Knowledge of CNC machining, fabrication, or precision manufacturing is a plus.
* Familiarity with quality assurance standards and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.


**Benefits:**
* Competitive Salary: We provide a compensation package that reflects your skills, contributions, and the value you bring to our team.
* Professional Development: Grow with us through training programs, mentorship, and internal promotion opportunities to advance your career.
* Lunch and snacks provided.


* Leave and Holidays:
+ Public National Holidays: 10 public holidays
+ Earned Vacation Leave: Take advantage of 15 days of paid vacation annually to recharge and relax.
+ Sick Leave: Prioritize your health with 5 days of paid sick leave for medical needs.
+ Casual Leave: 7 days
+ Birthday Leave: Celebrate your special day with an extra day off just for you.

title: Specialist, Technical Project Management
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Specialist, Technical Project Management
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

description:
**The Role**
 As a Senior Technical Project Manager at Vymo, you will lead our most complex, high\-value implementations for global financial institutions. You are the strategic face of Vymo to client leadership. You combine strong technical context with client empathy to turn complex requirements into smooth, on\-time go\-lives.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Client Delight \& Ownership: Own the full onboarding lifecycle for Tier\-1 global accounts from discovery to go\-live. Serve as the primary, trusted partner for client business and IT executives.
* Technical \& Integration Governance: Lead discovery on data flows, APIs, and middleware. Spot and resolve technical risks early in complex, regulated BFSI environments.
* Agile Execution \& Control: Run sprint cycles tied directly to business milestones. Owning scope, timeline, and change requests while enforcing strict engineering and security standards.
* Launch \& Hypercare: Drive go\-live readiness, code freeze, and deployment runbooks. Lead post\-launch hypercare, incident triage, and root cause analysis (RCA) to protect production stability.
* Leadership: Mentor junior project managers and refine Vymo’s global delivery playbook to scale best practices.


**What You Will Bring**
**Experience and Fluency**
* Industry Experience: 8–12 years of Technical Project Management experience, with at least 5\+ years in a B2B SaaS product company.
* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of managing product implementations within the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) sector.
* Global Delivery: Demonstrated experience delivering implementations for US\-based enterprise clients while collaborating with India\-based Engineering and Product teams.
* Technical Depth: Ability to evaluate APIs, data flows, and middleware architecture from a delivery lens without needing an engineer to translate.
* Agile Mastery: Advanced operational knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and JIRA execution. PMP, CSM, or equivalent certifications are a major advantage.
* Enterprise Execution: Experience managing multi\-stream technical projects with complex client integrations.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into business value for executive stakeholders.


**Mindset and Traits**
* High Agency: Extreme ownership. You do not wait for roadblocks to clear—you proactively solve problems and drive outcomes independently.
* Customer Obsession: Deep client empathy with a commitment to turning complex implementations into positive customer experiences.
* \\"Solve the Issue\\" Attitude: Calm under pressure during incidents, focused on immediate resolution, root cause elimination, and continuous improvement.

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. Amazon Projects team need to have in\-depth understanding of Project life cycle including span allocation for all the four pillars (assessment, design and detailing, Execution and Performance qualification) of any project. Some of the key aspects of the role are Site Selection along with the RE team, Project statutory and Legal compliances adherence, Project Safety both in terms of design and execution, value management for large and medium scale projects, executing various formats of technical projects\-green field, brown field and Improvement projects.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The candidate is required to lead the planning and execution of all building formats and will be for a specific region \- North India. The Project Manager role will be responsible for setting up new Centers across different business formats, capacity expansion of existing facilities as well as relocation of facilities as per business requirements. Additionally, the Project Manager will also drive 1 or 2 project management initiatives viz. Standardization, Energy Conservation programs, Productivity Improvement measures etc. and Project Financial processes.
   

  

 Project Manager will be responsible for the on time and safe delivery and hand over of facilities across business formats as listed above, ensuring that the project is executed with highest standards and good engineering practices. Other roles and responsibilities of the Project Manager will include
   

  

* Support RE Team in site visits and due diligence through site inspections for a feasibility assessment of setting up a facility for the given business format
* To work on finalizing the conceptual layouts and to assess the layout parameters from an operations perspective
* Preparing Developer’s Scope of Work for the site as per standards and specification
* Preparing Amazon scope of work and the cost estimate and preparation \& submission of Build out Capex request for approval.
* Finalization of Project Management Consultants
* Project resource planning and management through the appointed PMC or hired resources
* Work with Procurement team to evaluate and finalize vendors for the projects
* Reviewing the material requirement with all stakeholders for setting up and Launching the facility and tracking till receipt and implementation.
* Progress monitoring and Execution management of onsite activities of Amazon scope of work
* Tracking and ensuring quality of work by the Developer
* Ensure a snag\-free handover to Facilities Team
* Work with Launch team in preparation of the Launch of a site closer to completion
* Ensure budget adherence and safe execution at site \- with no budget overruns and with a targeted Zero LTI
* Preparation of weekly progress reviews and reports with status updates
* Ensure timely project closure including the commercials

 At RTX, you’ll have the opportunity to work on mission\-critical technologies, collaborate with some of the brightest minds in aerospace, and contribute to innovations that shape the future of flight.
   

  

**About Collins Aerospace**
 Collins Aerospace is a global leader in advanced aerospace and defense technologies, delivering intelligent, connected, and highly engineered solutions for the world’s most demanding missions.
   

  

 With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio spanning avionics, aircraft systems, software, and advanced technologies, Collins Aerospace helps customers meet the evolving demands of the global aerospace industry.
   

  

 Join us and be part of a team that is building the next generation of safe, intelligent, and connected aerospace systems.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Leader to join the Avionics – Core Services \& Libraries organization in Bangalore.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of middleware, core software libraries, and platform\-level software applications supporting Collins Aerospace avionics products.
   

  

 You will combine strong technical expertise with people leadership and program execution, guiding engineering teams through complex New Product Development programs and ensuring delivery against scope, schedule, cost, safety, and quality objectives.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for a technical leader who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, developing high\-performing teams, influencing stakeholders, and shaping next\-generation avionics software solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Technical \& Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Lead software engineering teams by providing clear technical direction, purpose, and motivation.
* Provide technical leadership for the development of middleware, core software libraries, and platform software applications.
* Lead software development across the product lifecycle, from initial planning through verification, validation, and certification.
* Guide teams developing software for real\-time operating systems, preferably VxWorks.
* Drive strong engineering practices, technical reviews, software quality, and continuous improvement.


 Program \& Project Leadership
   

  

* Develop and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, and delivery strategies.
* Drive execution across Scope, Schedule, Cost, Safety, and Quality objectives.
* Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure timely resolution of technical challenges.
* Present project status, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Ensure successful delivery of complex and integrated software solutions.


 Customer \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand technical requirements and expectations.
* Build strong relationships with customers, program teams, engineering teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Influence technical decisions and drive alignment across teams, even without direct authority.
* Manage technical changes and communicate project progress effectively.


 People \& Talent Leadership
   

  

* Set clear objectives and expectations for the engineering team.
* Monitor performance and ensure achievement of key technical and business targets.
* Hire, develop, mentor, and retain high\-performing engineering talent.
* Create opportunities for engineers to grow their technical and leadership capabilities.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborate closely with Systems, Hardware, Software, Program Management, Certification, and Engineering teams.
* Drive integration of complex software solutions across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Support new product development programs and ensure alignment with aerospace engineering and certification requirements.


**What You Will Learn**
 At Collins Aerospace, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise while working on mission\-critical avionics technologies.
   

  

 You will gain exposure to:
   

  

* Advanced avionics software architecture and platform technologies.
* Middleware and reusable core software libraries.
* Real\-time operating systems and safety\-critical software development.
* Aerospace software certification and DO\-178B/C processes.
* End\-to\-end product development from concept through certification.
* Large\-scale Agile engineering and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Customer and stakeholder management in a global aerospace environment.
* Leading and developing high\-performing technical teams.
* Emerging technologies, including AI/ML applications in engineering, automation, analytics, and digital transformation.


**Qualifications You Must Have**
* 12\+ years of relevant experience in embedded software, avionics software, middleware, platform software, or a related area.
* At least 1 year of leadership or people management experience.
* Strong experience in software design and development for avionics, aircraft applications, middleware, or platform\-level software.
* Experience leading software development on real\-time operating systems, preferably VxWorks.
* Experience working with cross\-functional engineering, certification, customer, and program teams.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and engineering processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions without direct authority.
* Strong focus on software quality, process compliance, safety, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced Agile environment with a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and customers.


**Qualifications We Prefer**
* Experience with middleware, core software libraries, or platform\-level software applications from planning through certification.
* Strong knowledge of DO\-178B/C, preferably at Design Assurance Level A (DAL A).
* Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with configuration management, requirements management, defect tracking, and revision\-control tools.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Git, Subversion, and JIRA.
* Experience managing complex New Product Development (NPD) programs.
* Experience working across global and geographically distributed engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder and customer management experience.
* Experience driving engineering process improvements and operational excellence.
* Exposure to AI/ML implementation in engineering design, automation, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and retain strong technical teams.


**Educational Qualification**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:
+ Computer Science Engineering
+ Electronics \& Communication Engineering
+ Avionics
+ Software Engineering
+ or another relevant engineering discipline.


 General Engineering Requirement:
   

  

 Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field with 5\+ years of relevant experience.
   

  

 For engineering/technical positions, a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) with relevant professional experience is typically required, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.
   

  

**Avionics**
 Our Avionics team advances aviation electronics and information management solutions for commercial and military customers across the world. That means we’re helping passengers reach their destination safely. We’re connecting aircraft operators, airports, rail and critical infrastructure with intelligent data service solutions that keep passengers, flight crews and militaries connected and informed. And we’re providing industry\-leading fire protection and safety systems that our customers can count on when it matters most. Are you ready to learn from the most knowledgeable experts in the industry, develop the technologies of tomorrow and reach new heights in your career? Join our Avionics team today.
