title: Program Manager II, WW FBA - SOps
description:
**Description**
 Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables millions of sellers worldwide to leverage Amazon's world\-class fulfillment network — from storage and pick\-pack\-ship to customer service and returns. FBA Support Operations (S\-Ops) is the team that ensures sellers receive best\-in\-class support throughout their FBA journey. We manage end\-to\-end seller support across multiple FBA programs, drive contact elimination through automation and process improvement, and continuously raise the bar on seller experience. Our mission is to make every seller interaction effortless — and where possible, eliminate the need for sellers to contact us at all.
   

  

 The FBA S\-Ops org is looking for a Program Manager who will launch and scale new seller engagement use cases, improve seller engagement ops efficiency, and drive Voice of Seller (VoS) solutions to close seller experience gaps. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle from intake to launch, surface seller pain points through data\-driven root\-cause analysis, and partner cross\-functionally to implement preventative fixes. You'll lead as a voice of the sellers for internal teams to ensure the right bar for seller experience, and systemic root cause fixes are in place to avoid recurring issues for our sellers.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. We are looking for someone who is detail\-driven, can create processes from scratch, has good problem solving and deep dive abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs while keeping a high bar on quality of outputs is a must.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end program lifecycle for new seller engagement use cases: intake, assessment, design, change management, launch, and BAU integration across multiple FBA programs
   

  

 Establish SOP's which promote the adoption of appropriate solutions and sustainability of desired results in complex operational environments and large scale launches
   

  

 Partner with WW FBA teams to prioritize and execute new use cases; coordinate across Capacity Planning, WFM, Training, SOP, and Seller Engagement Ops teams for seamless launches
   

  

 Work with product managers and leaders to ensure that strategies scale, and make smart trade\-offs (e.g., short\- vs. long\-term needs). Identify gaps between teams, processes and plans, and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate
   

  

 Own the VoS pipeline end\-to\-end: intake seller pain points, develop clear and concise root\-cause analysis (RCA) and write\-ups, implement solutions with cross\-functional owners, and measure impact
   

  

 Identify and close SX gaps through data\-driven insights and cross\-functional partnership with Product, Tech, and Policy teams
   

  

 Drive ops efficiency improvements — reducing waste, improving throughput, and optimizing seller engagement resource allocation
   

  

 Serve as escalation point for seller issues: own investigations to identify root\-causes, drive resolution, identify preventative solutions with cross\-functional business owners, and track progress through closure
   

  

 Deliver measurable improvements across key ops and SX metrics
   

  

 Collaborate and build relationships with cross functional teams to ensure seamless execution and process excellence

 We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:
   

  

 Bangalore, KA, IND

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience

This role owns the end\-to\-end program lifecycle — from ambiguous problem statements to scaled execution — driving operational excellence, service delivery improvements, and customer experience outcomes across multiple regions and time zones. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can independently structure complex problems, define program roadmaps, and deliver measurable results without waiting for perfect information. You will partner with global SD Operations leaders to identify gaps in service delivery, forecast accuracy, remote resolvability, and workforce planning — translating insights into actionable programs with clear milestones and accountability. The role requires influencing without authority across Product, TPM, and Field teams to align priorities, secure commitments, and drive adoption of SD\-led initiatives even when competing interests exist. You will lead negotiations with cross\-functional stakeholders on resource allocation, process ownership, and operational trade\-offs — maintaining composure and earning trust through data\-driven advocacy and transparent communication. This leader will own executive\-level reporting, business reviews, and program narratives that connect operational metrics to strategic outcomes, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions needed. You will drive continuous improvement by identifying systemic inefficiencies, designing scalable mechanisms, and embedding them into SD operations — from training frameworks and quality programs to automation adoption and self\-serve deflection strategies. The role demands high ownership — you treat every program as your own, proactively remove blockers, escalate decisively when needed, and hold cross\-functional partners accountable to shared commitments without damaging relationships. Experience managing global stakeholder landscapes (L6–L8\), navigating matrixed organizations, and delivering results in fast\-paced, high\-volume IT support environments is essential. The successful candidate brings 7\+ years of program management experience, strong analytical skills, exceptional written and verbal communication, and a demonstrated ability to earn trust, influence senior leaders, and deliver results at scale in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end lifecycle of global SD programs — from scoping problems to driving execution and delivering measurable outcomes across AMER, APAC, EU, and LATAM. Partner with Operations, Product, TPM, and Field Engineering leaders to align priorities, negotiate resource allocation, and drive shared accountability across matrixed teams. Own executive reporting, business reviews, and program narratives connecting operational metrics to strategic outcomes. Drive CSAT/DSAT analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective actions in partnership with Training and Quality teams. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**About Valeo Health** 




 Valeo Health is a preventive healthcare and wellness platform operating across Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), offering diagnostics, teleconsultation, AI\-driven health insights, supplements, and care programs. We are building AI\-first, compliant, and scalable healthcare platforms that handle sensitive health data while delivering reliable, high\-quality customer experiences across geographies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the POD that builds and operates Valeo's compliance and finance platforms across KSA and the UAE. Your POD owns the integrations that keep Valeo legal and running — connecting to national health data exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati, NPHIES) and to Saudi Arabia's ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) — end\-to\-end, from design and build through certification, go\-live, and ongoing operation.
 



  





 This is a backend\- and integration\-heavy role where correctness is non\-negotiable — regulators, auditors, and patients depend on it. Driving AI adoption is a must: you will build AI into the platforms and roll out AI\-assisted engineering across the team, while holding an uncompromising bar on data privacy and security (HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, KSA PDPL).
 



  





**The Mindset We Hire For** 




 These three traits matter more than any specific technology on your CV. If they don't describe you, this is not the right role.
 



 •
 **Ownership:** 
 You don't escalate problems — you bring solutions. When a regulatory deadline or an
 



 integration is at risk, you own it end to end until it's resolved.
 



 •
 **Deliver Results:** 
 You measure your POD in systems shipped, integrations certified, and reliability
 



 improved — not stand\-ups attended.
 



 •
 **AI\-Forward \& Quick to Learn:** 
 You actively adopt AI tools, get productive fast in unfamiliar
 



 regulatory domains, and bring AI into your team's workflow without compromising compliance.
 



  





**What We Expect from Our Engineering Managers** 




**Own Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of compliance and finance integration platforms through a POD model.
 



 • Translate dense regulatory and tax requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans.
 



 • Balance speed, quality, reliability, and compliance — and know where there is zero tolerance for
 



 error.
 



**Build Reliable Regulatory \& Finance Integrations** 




 • Deliver and operate integrations with UAE health exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati) and KSA
 



 NPHIES, using HL7 / FHIR.
 



 • Build ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) Phase 2 — UBL / XML, cryptographic stamps, QR codes,
 



 clearance/reporting, and platform onboarding.
 



 • Engineer resilient, observable integrations — retries, idempotency, reconciliation, and monitoring
 



 against external platforms.
 



**Drive AI Adoption (a must)** 




 • Build AI into the platforms — document extraction, data mapping and validation, claims/coding
 



 assistance, invoice reconciliation, and anomaly detection.
 



 • Roll out AI\-assisted engineering (coding, review, test generation, agentic workflows) to raise team
 



 throughput and quality.
 



 • Establish safe patterns for AI on regulated data — no PHI/PII exposure to third\-party models, with
 



 evals and guardrails.
 



**Build Secure \& Compliant Systems** 




 • Ensure secure SDLC and data\-privacy requirements across services and AI systems.
 



 • Collaborate with Compliance, Security, and Legal on HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, and KSA
 



 PDPL.
 



 • Maintain audit readiness, certification, and documentation for regulator and government\-platform
 



 onboarding.
 



**Lead Teams Effectively** 




 • Manage and mentor a POD of 8–10 engineers.
 



 • Drive sprint planning, estimation, execution, and delivery predictability.
 



 • Upskill the team on applied AI and modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
 



 • Make hiring decisions and grow the team in line with business priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own delivery and operation of compliance and finance integration platforms across KSA and UAE.
 



 • Own the roadmap for embedding AI into the platforms and adopting AI tooling across the team.
 



 • Manage certification, onboarding, and go\-live with regulators and government platforms.
 



 • Drive incident response, root\-cause analysis, and post\-mortems for integrations and AI systems.
 



 • Define and track reliability, data\-quality, and audit\-readiness metrics and SLAs.
 



 • Partner with Product, Compliance, Finance, and Legal on PDPL, HIPAA, and ISO 27001
 



 obligations.
 



 • Work with DevOps/SRE for uptime, scalability, and cost efficiency; hire and grow the team.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Experience** 




 • 5–10 years of software engineering experience, with a strong backend/integrations focus.
 



 • 2–4\+ years as an Engineering Manager or Senior Tech Lead managing 6 or more engineers.
 



 • Track record delivering compliance\-heavy or regulated integrations end\-to\-end.
 



 • Experience integrating with government or regulatory platforms is a strong plus.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong backend systems, APIs, and distributed / integration patterns — queues, retries,
 



 idempotency, reconciliation.
 



 • Healthcare data standards (HL7 / FHIR) and e\-invoicing/tax formats (UBL / XML), or ability to
 



 master them fast.
 



 • Applied AI: LLM integration, RAG, model serving and evaluation; plus AI\-assisted engineering
 



 tooling.
 



 • AWS or GCP, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and observability tools.
 



 • Data security, encryption, and PII/PHI handling; understanding of AI data governance.
 



**Leadership \& Mindset** 




 • Strong people\-management and stakeholder\-communication skills.
 



 • Proven ability to drive change and AI adoption across an engineering team.
 



 • Ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and a compliance\-first mindset.
 



 • High ownership, bias for action, and customer\-first mindset.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)** 




 • The required KSA and UAE health\-exchange and ZATCA integrations are live and compliant, on
 



 regulatory timelines.
 



 • AI is embedded in the platforms and in the team's workflow, with measurable gains in effort and
 



 quality.
 



 • Improved integration reliability and a reduction in production issues.
 



 • Clean audits, with audit\-ready documentation across owned systems.
 



 • Strong team growth — including at least one engineer ready for promotion within the year.
 



  





**Why Join Valeo Health**

 • High\-impact role at the intersection of healthcare regulation, finance, and AI.
 



 • Clear growth path toward Senior Engineering Manager and leadership roles.

title: AI Business Consultant
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Avaali Solutions is looking for an AI Business Consultant who will serve as the bridge between enterprise business challenges and AI\-powered solutions delivered through our proprietary Avagama platform. This role combines business consulting acumen with hands\-on platform delivery \- you will engage directly with customers to understand their processes, identify automation and intelligence opportunities, and own the end\-to\-end build of solutions including agentic AI workflows, intelligent document processing pipelines, and process orchestration layers.
 



 You will work within the Agentic AI \& Intelligent Automation Practice, collaborating with delivery teams, pre\-sales, and product engineering to position and deploy Avagama\-powered solutions across industries including BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, and facilities management.
 



  





**ABOUT AVAGAMA** 




 Avagama is Avaali's proprietary SAP\-aware enterprise process intelligence and agentic AI orchestration platform. It enables organizations to discover, analyze, and automate complex business processes by combining process mining, AI\-driven decision intelligence, and an agentic orchestration engine that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step enterprise workflows autonomously. Avagama is designed for deep SAP integration while remaining vendor\-agnostic across ERP and enterprise landscapes.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Business Discovery \& Process Understanding** 



* Conduct structured discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to map current\-state business processes, pain points, and transformation goals.
* Translate business process narratives into structured process maps, value\-stream views, and opportunity catalogues.
* Identify areas where AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, or process orchestration can create measurable business value.



**Avagama Platform Consulting \& Solutioning** 



* Use Avagama's process intelligence capabilities to analyze process data, mine patterns, and surface automation and AI applicability.
* Map business requirements to Avagama's agentic orchestration, IDP, and decision\-intelligence modules to design fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Build solution architectures and present them to customer CxO / IT leadership with clear ROI articulation.
* Identify where agentic AI agents should be deployed versus rule\-based automation, and design hybrid orchestration strategies.



  





**Solution Build \& Delivery Ownership** 



* Own the hands\-on build of Avagama\-based solutions \- configure agents, define orchestration workflows, set up IDP pipelines, and integrate with enterprise systems (SAP, ERPs, CRMs, custom APIs).
* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents that perform multi\-step enterprise tasks: approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, document classification, and data extraction.
* Collaborate with data engineers and ML engineers for model tuning, prompt engineering, and performance optimization where custom AI components are required.
* Ensure solution quality through structured testing, UAT coordination, and go\-live support.



  





**Client Engagement \& Value Realization** 



* Serve as the primary consultant on customer engagements \- own the relationship from discovery through steady\-state handover.
* Build business cases, ROI models, and transformation roadmaps aligned with client KPIs.
* Conduct training and enablement sessions for client teams on deployed solutions.
* Produce engagement artifacts: process assessment reports, opportunity catalogues, solution design documents, and post\-deployment value reports.



  





**Pre\-Sales \& Practice Contribution** 



* Support pre\-sales with discovery\-driven scoping, effort estimation, and proposal inputs.
* Contribute to Avagama's positioning \- case studies, competitive intelligence, demo scenarios, and sales training content.
* Feed product insights back to the platform engineering team based on real\-world deployment learnings.



  





**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 4–8 years of experience in business consulting, process consulting, or technology consulting in an enterprise context.
* Demonstrate ability to independently run discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process mapping exercises.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of: process mining tools, RPA platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate), or intelligent automation platforms.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems \- SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP), or equivalent ERP/CRM landscapes.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts \- LLMs, prompt engineering, document AI, and agentic AI patterns (tool use, ReAct, multi\-agent orchestration).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into concrete solution designs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- comfort presenting to CxO audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Experience with SAP integration technologies \- BTP, SAP AI Core, Joule, ArchiveLink, VIM, or xECM.
* Familiarity with GCP Document AI, Azure Document Intelligence, or AWS Textract.
* Prior experience building or configuring AI agents or multi\-agent orchestration systems.
* Exposure to industry domains such as BFSI, manufacturing, energy, retail, or facilities management.
* Certifications in SAP, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or any cloud AI/ML specialization.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.

title: Product/Project Manager - Gen Ai
description:
Role \- Product Manager/Project Manager/Technical Project Manager
 



  





 Location \- Bangalore

 JD:
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 AI Product Strategy \& Roadmap
 



 • Translate inputs into AI product requirements, use cases, value propositions, and roadmap recommendations.
 



 • Build fact\-based business cases connecting AI capability to customer outcomes, revenue opportunity, cost and margin impact, and strategic fit.

 Program Planning \& Execution
 



 • Prepare project plans and drive initiatives from conception and planning through implementation, deployment, and adoption.

 Technical Partnership \& Delivery Quality
 



 • Partner with Business, Data Science, ML Engineering, Data Platform, and Software teams to ensure requirements are understood, feasible, prioritized, and traceable through execution.
 



 • Drive definition of evaluation criteria and acceptance thresholds for AI systems.
 



 • Own the path from pilot to production: MLOps readiness, monitoring, model drift management, support model, and total cost of ownership.
 



  





 Customer, Field \& Competitive Insight
 



 • Engage customer\-facing stakeholders and technical experts to understand customer high\-value problems and operational pain points.
 



 • Capture and synthesize Voice of Customer, escalation learnings, and competitive intelligence into actionable AI product recommendations.
 



 • Support customer and executive technical reviews with product positioning, technical rationale, and evidence\-based messaging.

 Cross\-Functional Leadership
 



 • Drive alignment of system\-level requirements across Business Units, Engineering, IT, Services, and Operations.

 • Maintain clear documentation of product decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
 



 • Use structured operating rhythms, dashboards, and reviews to communicate progress and escalate appropriately.

 Required

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high\-stakes, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end\-to\-end program delivery plans for multi\-team initiatives, translating high\-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.
* Architecture \& Dependency Management: Identify, track, and resolve complex cross\-functional dependencies across API contracts, core platform services, and external integrations.
* Technical Problem Solving: Drive alignment on system trade\-offs (e.g., latency, scalability, technical debt) and participate in architectural reviews to keep execution aligned with long\-term platform health.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical, security, and operational risks weeks before they impact launch schedules, building actionable contingency plans.
* Operational Excellence: Establish a lightweight, high\-impact execution cadence (e.g., agile delivery processes, integration testing syncs, execution metrics, post\-mortems) across distributed engineering teams.
* Executive Communication: Synthesize technical status, risks, and execution health into clear, data\-driven updates for senior leadership.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 7\+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service\-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
* Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large\-scale, multi\-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
* Leadership \& Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.
* Data\-Driven: Proficiency with program management frameworks (Jira, Confluence) and using metrics to measure delivery velocity and system reliability.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in ad tech, data engineering, complex integrations (e.g., third\-party verification, SDK integrations), or high\-throughput real\-time systems.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Senior Program Manager, Quality – GTM Vendor Solutions
description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a strategic and highly collaborative Senior Program Manager, Quality to lead Quality orchestration across the GTM Vendor Solutions (GTMVS) ecosystem. This role will be responsible for driving a consistent, scalable, and data\-driven quality framework across our global vendor programs supporting both Sales and Support motions.
   

  





 The Senior Program Manager will serve as the central point of orchestration between GTMVS, business stakeholders, program managers, and our external Quality partner which provides Third\-Party Quality Assurance (3PQA) across our vendor programs.
   

  





 This role goes beyond quality reporting. The successful candidate will translate business priorities into quality strategies, identify systemic risks and opportunities, drive accountability across stakeholders and vendors, and use data and insights to influence operational decisions and improve customer and business outcomes.
   

  





 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who understands how Sales and Support organizations operate, is highly analytical, communicates with executive presence, and can navigate complex stakeholder environments. They will be equally comfortable defining a quality strategy, challenging assumptions with data, diving into operational details, and holding internal and external partners accountable for outcomes.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  





 1\. Quality Strategy \& Orchestration
   

  




* Own and evolve the GTMVS quality operating model across global vendor programs supporting Sales and Support.


* Translate business priorities, customer expectations, and operational goals into clear quality strategies, frameworks, and measurement mechanisms.


* Establish consistent quality standards, methodologies, governance, and ways of working across vendor programs while allowing for appropriate program\-level flexibility.


* Partner with GTMVS leadership and business stakeholders to define quality priorities, identify emerging risks, and establish measurable improvement goals.


* Serve as the strategic quality advisor to Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and operational leaders.


* Continuously assess the effectiveness of the quality model and identify opportunities to simplify, scale, automate, and innovate.



 2\. 3PQA Vendor Management \& Accountability
   

  




* Own the strategic partnership and operating model with our 3PQA Vendor provider across GTMVS programs.


* Establish clear expectations, performance standards, SLAs, governance mechanisms, and accountability frameworks for the quality partner.


* Orchestrate quality execution across programs, ensuring consistent sampling, evaluations, calibration, reporting, and feedback mechanisms.


* Hold the vendor accountable for quality outcomes, delivery against commitments, and continuous improvement.


* Identify gaps in vendor performance and lead structured remediation plans, ensuring actions have clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.


* Build a strong partnership with Vendors while maintaining the appropriate level of rigor, challenge, and accountability.



 3\. Quality Analytics, Insights \& Business Impact
   

  




* Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of quality performance across vendor programs, identifying trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities.


* Analyze quality data alongside operational metrics to identify the drivers of performance and understand the impact on customer experience, productivity, revenue, and business outcomes.


* Move beyond reporting metrics to provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership.


* Establish mechanisms to identify systemic issues and recurring failure patterns across programs and vendors.


* Partner with Analytics, Operations, Training, WFM, and other GTMVS functions to connect quality insights to broader operational performance.


* Develop executive\-level reporting and business reviews that clearly articulate performance, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.



 4\. Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Influence
   

  




* Act as the central quality partner across GTMVS, connecting Vendor Management, Program Management, Operations, Training, Analytics, and business stakeholders.


* Build strong relationships with Sales and Support leaders and understand the distinct operating models, customer journeys, and quality requirements of each motion.


* Influence senior stakeholders and vendor leadership without direct authority to drive alignment and action.


* Facilitate quality governance forums, business reviews, calibrations, and performance discussions.


* Create clear communication mechanisms that ensure quality insights and expectations are understood and acted upon across internal and external teams.


* Confidently challenge stakeholders when performance, process, or quality outcomes do not meet expectations.



 5\. Continuous Improvement \& Innovation
   

  




* Identify opportunities to improve quality processes, methodologies, tooling, and operating mechanisms.


* Drive initiatives that improve the scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness of the 3PQA model.


* Explore and implement innovative approaches, including automation, AI\-enabled quality analysis, and new methods of identifying customer and operational insights.


* Partner with Training and Operations to ensure quality findings translate into meaningful coaching, enablement, and process improvements.


* Establish closed\-loop feedback mechanisms that connect Quality → Insights → Coaching/Training → Operational Improvement → Business Outcomes.


* Develop scalable playbooks and best practices that can be adopted across global vendor programs.



 6\. Quality Governance \& Operational Excellence
   

  




* Establish robust governance mechanisms to ensure quality programs operate consistently and effectively across vendors and geographies.


* Maintain clear documentation of quality standards, methodologies, processes, and decision rights.


* Drive regular calibration and alignment across internal stakeholders and the 3PQA partner.


* Monitor adherence to quality requirements and proactively identify operational or compliance risks.


* Establish structured action tracking and escalation mechanisms to ensure commitments are delivered.



 Drive a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, and accountability across the quality ecosystem.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  




* 5\+ years of experience in Program Management, Quality, Operations, Vendor Management, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience working with external vendors, BPOs, or third\-party operational partners.
* Experience working in either Sales, Customer Support, Customer Success, or another customer\-facing operational environment.



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* Proven experience managing complex, cross\-functional programs across global teams and external partners.
* Strong understanding of Sales and/or Support operating models, workflows, and performance metrics.
* Experience designing or managing Quality Assurance / Quality Management programs, preferably in a BPO or outsourced operating model.
* Demonstrated ability to translate data and operational metrics into actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Good analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and connect quality performance to business outcomes.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and external partners without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to hold internal and external stakeholders accountable while maintaining strong, collaborative relationships.
* Experience managing vendor performance through governance, SLAs, KPIs, business reviews, and structured improvement plans.
* Experience driving process improvement, operational excellence, or transformation initiatives.
* Good executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and clearly articulate recommendations.
* Demonstrated curiosity and an innovation mindset, with a willingness to challenge existing processes and explore new technologies, tools, and approaches.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to balance strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.
* Experience working across geographically distributed teams and global vendor ecosystems.
* Experience in Reporting, Analytics \& Automation: Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Automate, Tableau, and AI\-enabled automation tools, with the ability to support data analysis, reporting, workflow automation, and dashboard development.



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* Strategic Program Management
* Quality Management \& Continuous Improvement
* Vendor Management \& Accountability
* Stakeholder Management \& Influence
* Data \& Analytics
* Sales \& Support Operations
* Executive Communication

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS Brand Experience (BX)
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!
   

  

 Retail Business Services (RBS) Brand Experience (BX) leverages technology to improve customer experience and selling partner experience while lowering Amazon’s cost structure. Vision of RBS is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by 1\) improving the customer experience by fixing detail page catalog defects at scale, 2\) improving selling partner listing quality to drive GMS and reducing fulfillment defects to drive profitability and 3\) improving store operations efficiency by driving down cost of operations. We strive to eliminate the root cause of the defect and wherever not possible, we leverage machine learning to find and fix at scale or surface to selling partners. RBS has multiple programs/services aimed at reducing the listing friction, improving listing quality, reducing customer returns and improving star ratings of products that are dependent on selling partner support for effective execution.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the development and innovation of products and features to improve brand experience for WW brands. You will be expected to identify the brand requirements using primary \& secondary research, gather business and systems requirements from internal and external stakeholders, propose and validate solutions, build proof\-of\-concepts, write specifications, drive roadmap from design to release, and manage the production launch. You will work with our internal/external product, business and technology teams to align on roadmap, prioritization, execution, navigating ambiguity and removing roadblocks while sustaining launch/expansion velocity. You will leverage your team to provide solutions that address peripheral needs (functional, legal, compliance). In addition, you will work closely on driving adoption of the product in your target segments, improving actionability of the insights you share through the initiative, and maintaining the quality of product features. You will own the reporting of metrics, and launches through business reviews at leadership level.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to customer experience improvement. Key skills for the role include an extraordinary ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the tech product.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build deep knowledge of RBS BX offerings, and business requirements.
* Develop trust\-based relationships with program’s key stakeholders.
* Help define the program strategies, develop program roadmap, and organize work steams and milestones; gain buy\-in and interlock across functional and regional leaders.
* Manage timely and successful delivery of the program, working with program’s product owners and cross\-functional teams to manage risks, and measure and report on progress. Gather and analyze data on launch performance results
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, manage escalations, balance trade\-offs, and resolve complex execution and operational issues.
* Build and deliver program’s operational and management reports. Use data and analytics to make day\-to\-day business decisions and achieve results
* Work with global and regional teams to lead program’s adoption efforts. Hold regular business reviews with both internal and external partners
* Define and manage to program KPIs. Use Voice of the Customer, experimentation, data analysis, to set global quality standards and specifications for all product media for Amazon
* Present strategic program and user insights and recommendations to stakeholders and cross\-functional team.
* Provide ad\-hoc support and analysis to senior leaders on strategy documents and research requests.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
